question: Will this work on black people? I am medium brown complexion
gold_answer: The Flash & Go uses Pulsed Light Technology and therefore is not suitable for use on dark skin tones. It is equally unsuitable for use on light hair colours for the same reason. So you will want to confirm with both Chamberlain and Chevrolet if your year and model car will be able to transmit the new codes.
